The holiday season brings the best deals of the year, and for anyone looking to upgrade to an ergonomic office chair, Sihoo’s Doro C300 Pro V2 is now available at its lowest price of the year.

Sihoo Doro C300 Pro V2 Ergonomic Office Chair available at lowest price of the year, here’s what it offers

We’re entering the holiday season, and while shopping and seasonal events might make things busier than usual, the goal is always for a time of rest, unwinding, and recharging for the new year.

But comfort and coziness don’t have to be isolated to the final month or two of each year. With a Sihoo Doro C300 Pro V2 Ergonomic Office Chair, you can upgrade to all-year comfort even while getting work done.

It’s hard to overstate the importance of owning the right office chair. For something you’re going to spend much of your daily life sitting in, it’s worth it to maximize comfort.

Here are the key features of Sihoo’s Doro C300 Pro V2:

  • Full-body ergonomic support for everyone
  • SyncroFlex™ back-glide keeps your back supported in all the right places
  • DynaCore™ synchronized support means the chair adapts to your every move
  • Domino™ sacral-lumbar support works even when you lean and recline
  • Smart weight-sensing recline adjusts recline resistance automatically
  • Adjustable pressure-relief seat gives long-lasting comfort
  • 8D bio-adaptive armrests can match any resting style
  • Ultra-wide 3D headrest provides abundant room to rest

If the chair doesn’t work out for you, there’s a 30-day hassle-free return policy to get your money back. And Sihoo provides a 36-month extended warranty for the chair with every purchase.

Sihoo’s Doro C300 Pro V2 is now available at its lowest price of the year, and 9to5Mac readers get a special discount using code Sihoo9to5 to bring the price even lower.

  • Original price: $499.99
  • Black Friday Promotional Price: $409.99
  • Final price after 9to5Mac discount code: $385.39

You can buy directly from Sihoo here, just use the discount code Sihoo9to5 for the lowest price. The chair is also available here on Amazon.

Don’t wait around to upgrade your office setup, Sihoo’s best price is available now.
